description: Interactive tours and site visit documentation for the potential fish passage project at the Spurgeon Creek crossing at Rainier Road (WDFW FPDSI  #342433). Each tour combines 360 degree photos with aerial and drone imagery and a site map. Select a tour to explore its stops, and use the map to see where each photo was taken.
